text:
Maya Tran: Quick check — I opened a small Terraform change (PR below) to move the DB credential secret path from `secrets/app/old` -> `secrets/app/kms-wrapped` and bump the web deployment resources. Before I land it, I want to confirm rollout strategy: currently `Deployment.spec.strategy.type: RollingUpdate` with `maxSurge: 25%` and `maxUnavailable: 25%`. If we keep 25% surge the new pods spike DB connections concurrently and our read replicas hit connection limits. Thoughts on dropping `maxSurge` to 0 and lowering `maxUnavailable` to 10% for a slower, safer rollout? Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/842
Thomas K: +1 on reducing surge for this one. Especially since secret path change triggers pods to restart and re-acquire creds — we shouldn't double the active connections during rollout.
Jin Park: Agree. If we set `maxSurge: 0` the rollout will effectively be sequential (old pods terminate before new create) depending on available capacity. That reduces peak connections but increases rollout duration — fine for webtier.
Maya Tran: Also changing resource requests: bump cpu from `100m` -> `200m` and mem `256Mi` -> `384Mi` for the new image; TF change includes that. Wanted to make sure ops is okay with the temporary extra resource usage.
Samir: ok on resources. Could we combine with prefix caching to lower connection churn? Not for this PR but note for follow-up.
Thomas K: One more concern — if `maxSurge: 0` and there's a HPA/cluster-autoscaler delay, we might briefly drop capacity. Recommend setting `maxUnavailable: 5%` instead of 10% to avoid user-visible capacity loss.
Maya Tran: Good point. So proposal: `maxSurge: 0`, `maxUnavailable: 5%`. I'll update PR. Also in k8s manifest we need to switch the secretRef path used by the pod envFrom. Current snippet:
```
envFrom:
  - secretRef:
      name: app-credentials
```
Terraform will change the external secret controller mapping to point to `secrets/app/kms-wrapped` and create `app-credentials` in-cluster. Verified with `kubectl get secret app-credentials -n prod` after apply locally.
Jin Park: Sounds good. Add a note in the PR description about manual watch steps: `kubectl rollout status deploy/web -n prod` and `kubectl get pods -o wide` to watch for restart storms.
Samir: Can we add a short post-deploy check in our deploy pipeline? Like a simple TCP check against DB connection pool metrics or `curl /health` latency threshold for 10 minutes after rollout. If it regresses, auto-roll back.
Maya Tran: Filing a follow-up ticket for the post-deploy check. For this PR I'll keep the change minimal: update TF secret mapping, bump resources, `maxSurge: 0`, `maxUnavailable: 5%`. If CI + staging looks good I'll merge midday.
deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: lint: OK, tfplan: OK (no unexpected changes), infra-tests: pending
Thomas K: thanks Maya — ping me on review when ready :thumbsup:
Maya Tran: Will do. ETA ~30m for updated diffs.
